# Necto

> Necto helps finance students land coffee chats. It finds investment banking analysts with verified email addresses, researches each person before writing, generates a personalized cold email, and tracks which emails still need a follow-up.

## Product
- [Home](https://usenecto.com): Main landing page and signup

## About
Necto is a live SaaS tool for finance students at target schools (Wharton, Stern, Ross, Georgetown, Notre Dame) recruiting for investment banking roles. Coverage is investment banking only: every bulge bracket and elite boutique bank, with 2,600+ contacts that have a verified email address. Search filters are firm, city, seniority, and Cornell alumni. Free plan includes 10 emails per month.
